items.title: Healthcare IT (Nashville's Most Distinctive Industry)
items.description: Nashville is the US's healthcare IT capital — HCA Healthcare (Nashville HQ, largest for-profit hospital operator), Vanderbilt University Medical Center, LifePoint Health, Ardent Health Services, and a remarkable concentration of healthcare IT companies including Envision Healthcare, Parallon, and dozens of healthcare technology startups. Clinical AI for Nashville health systems: HIPAA-compliant patient risk stratification, clinical documentation AI, and revenue cycle optimization for HCA's and LifePoint's hospital networks. Healthcare IT product AI: AI capabilities embedded in the Nashville healthcare IT software products used by hospitals across the US — prior authorization automation, clinical coding assistance, patient engagement AI, and healthcare analytics. Interoperability AI: FHIR-compliant data integration and LLM-powered clinical data normalization for Nashville's health information exchange and interoperability technology companies.
items.label: Healthcare IT

items.title: Music and Entertainment Technology
items.description: Nashville's music industry — Universal Music Group Nashville, Sony Music Nashville, Warner Music Nashville, and hundreds of independent labels — is increasingly AI-active: music analytics AI (predicting streaming performance, radio airplay, and commercial viability from audio features and artist attribute data); rights and royalties intelligence (NLP for music publishing administration — contract parsing, royalty calculation AI, and publishing catalog analytics); content recommendation (personalized music recommendation for streaming platforms with Nashville music catalog access).
